targetRepo.description: Absolute path of the cloned target repo this run drove the setup flow against.

harnessSource.description: Where the harness core was installed from for this run.

harnessInstalled.description: `harness doctor` ran against the target after install and returned an envelope.

harnessabilityGrade.description: verdict.final_grade from the harnessability assessment (A–F), or null if the assessment did not produce one.

axisTuple.description: The two-axis tuple from the assessment verdict — the primary result the final_grade must never mask.

assessmentReportPaths.description: Where the assessment wrote, inside the clone, relative or absolute.

abandoned.description: True when the worker stopped after the assessment because its report judged the repo poorly harnessable. Not a hard failure; a valid, useful outcome.

abandonReason.description: Human-readable reason for abandonment (e.g. grade + which axis failed). Null when not abandoned.

bootAuthored.description: True when a `boot` extension was authored via the harness's own tooling (not hand-written) and shows as loaded in `harness doctor`.

bootRuns.description: True when invoking the boot extension returned an honest Envelope (ok / degraded / unconfigured with next_action) — independently verified, not trusting the skill's self-report.

bootPath.description: The .harness/extensions/boot.<ext> path in the clone, or null.

retroRecorded.description: True when a retro record was created and filled in the clone via the harness's own retro mechanism.

retroRecordPaths.description: Paths to the retro record files this run authored in the clone (consumed by the orchestrator --collect rollup).

verdict.description: PASS only when the clone ends with a working, proven harness (installed + assessed + a boot that runs honestly + a retro recorded). ABANDONED when the worker stopped on its assessment's judgement (reported, not FAILed). FAIL on any other broken step.

summary.description: What happened, end to end, in a few sentences.

retrospective.description: Dual-layer retrospective. project = the harness CLI / skills / docs; minih = the runner / skill passing / permissions.

category.description: build | config | data | test | debug | knowledge | other
